## EarthGuard – Smart Environmental and Disaster Monitoring Platform

**EarthGuard** is an innovative, technology-driven platform designed to monitor environmental conditions, analyze natural disasters, and support smarter emergency response.

The platform combines interactive maps, environmental data, and advanced analytical tools to provide insights into global and regional conditions. Its key features include atmospheric humidity monitoring, carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions analysis, population density visualization, thermal mapping, and disaster risk assessment.

EarthGuard also explores post-disaster signal detection, building safety information, and location-based analysis to help improve situational awareness and support rescue operations.

By integrating scientific data, geographic information systems (GIS), and interactive visualizations, EarthGuard aims to make complex environmental information accessible and understandable.
